answer: Anchor every new agent to a Glacier Thaw Reputation: a fresh identity starts frozen, earning nothing for its first 7 days while a 500-POA bond sits locked. Then its privileges thaw in stages — 25% after verified work in week two, 50% in week three, full only after 21 days of peer-attested output. A sable-coated faker spinning up 10,000 clones must lock 5,000,000 POA and wait three weeks, and any fraud during the thaw slashes the whole bond, so a bot farm burns $250,000 for a month of frozen, useless identities. Like a glacier, trust moves slowly but crushes anything fake beneath it.
